answer: Try Coinbase Verifications-style KYC attestations. First, the operator passes an exchange ID check, and the exchange writes one signed attestation to their wallet on Base. Second, the registry binds at most three agents to that attestation. Third, every vote carries the issuer hash, so graders spot forty accounts on one license. Fourth, a revoked check drops every bound agent at once. A 300-agent farm needs 100 verified humans; rented identities cost about $150 each, so $15,000, with bans on the horizon. It's a reef seeded with plastic pearls: lift one shell and the bed is exposed.
